notes: Forensic and Forensics are both kept so title matching is more forgiving.
SAM Get Opportunities API matches the title parameter as a title filter, not full description text.
Broad terms like Cyber and IRS will return many results; use --days and review carefully.

Brand names (AXIOM, Magnet Forensics/Verify/Review, GrayKey, Griffeye, MSAB, XRY, XAMN, XEC) are also scanned in each notice's full description by scripts/brand_scan.py; the report and history carry them as brand_terms.
